# Plan crosswalk: delivery routing and loss check

This index supports [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md#the-execution-order). It is not
a second roadmap or a replacement for any linked criterion or design.
Baseline: `58d3535467dc330f1baf1a69936d683c778a3d18` on `claude/plan-rev2`, checked 2026-10-05.

Rows identify source list items (including nested items), table data rows,
and section/PX entries at that immutable baseline. Section entries also
retain prose-only obligations. PX entries cover the complete experiment design. The full source and continuation
paragraphs remain authoritative. Excerpts are navigation labels, not complete
specifications. Dependencies and acceptance evidence are the intersection of
the destination part's roadmap row and the source item's existing rules.
Unmarked rows are retained with their source status. A recorded checkmark
means evidence is recorded, not that it qualifies every present configuration.
No historical failure is promoted to a pass by this index.

The current decision state is ROADMAP's register plus its dated amendments.
DECISIONS supplies the original owner wording. Rows spanning several parts
must be split into bounded PRs without dropping their sub-items. The archived
registers below also retain items already completed or outside this roadmap.
An unassigned outside item remains explicitly deferred pending classification,
not silently discarded or activated.

## Historical execution steps

| Old step      | Destination                               | Disposition                                                                           |
|:------------- |:----------------------------------------- |:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 0, 1, 1b      | 1, 4 and 5, plus the energy guard in 11c. | Reuse existing implementation and evidence. PX0 retained.                             |
| 2, 2a, 6a, 6b | 6, 8                                      | Isolation, PX1/7/8 retained. Low screen does not waive PX8.                           |
| 3, 8          | 8, 12c                                    | OD8 counts and cost-before-selection retained.                                        |
| 4, 5          | 6, 8, 9                                   | Copies eligibility and explicit-1M default gates retained. Option D limits D4-W work. |
| 6, 7b         | 8, 9                                      | WP4c and PP-SUB trigger retained. No automatic adoption.                              |
| 6c            | 5, 6, 10                                  | PX24/PX11 before PX23. Independent held-out hygiene.                                  |
| 7, 8b         | 7, 8, 9, 10                               | Separate reference, implementation and qualification. Keep EDMF stages.               |
| 8a            | 8, 9                                      | Negative-parent/follower probe obligations and thresholds retained.                   |
| 8c            | 4                                         | Verdict records, manual until PX21 is justified. OD9 labels remain proposed.          |
| 9, 11         | 12d                                       | OD6 long-run gates and cost pilot retained.                                           |
| 10, 10a       | 3, 11a–d                                  | Energy contract, PX22, mirrors/cross blocks and qualification retained.               |

## Maintenance

When closing a destination PR, update its live task and status with the exact
commit, test/run evidence and remaining limitation. Do not rewrite this pinned
baseline. Add a disposition amendment here if a source obligation is replaced,
with the reason and owner decision. All numerical thresholds, experimental
triggers and named failure records remain in their existing authoritative
documents. This index records no new simulation result.
